svg.title: MEXA, Autonomous digital self research
svg.desc: MEXA. Autonomous digital self research. Randomized conditions, server-side logic. LLM orchestration with safety constraints. Built for a planned 300+ participant study. Next.js/React, Supabase/PostgreSQL. Start the walk, sathishlella.online.
